title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität

extraction.summaryEn: Police searched four properties in Kreuzberg and Neukölln in connection with a weapons law violation, seizing a concealed pistol, ammunition and a blank-firing/signal weapon. Four suspects aged 19 to 35 are under investigation.
